analysis: The trial executed successfully but reduced pinned-host macro validation HR@10 to 0.535, down 0.0363 from 0.5713 and 0.0387 from 0.5737. Category HR@10 was 0.570 for Movies_and_TV, 0.570 for Industrial_and_Scientific, 0.410 for Electronics, and 0.590 for CDs_and_Vinyl. These results do not support independent candidate embeddings in this configuration. Separating embeddings removes parameter sharing between history and candidate roles and increases parameters; weaker statistical sharing is a plausible explanation, but the reported metrics do not establish the cause. No per-category comparator or training curves were supplied, so category-specific regressions and convergence behavior cannot be determined.
code_summary: One jointly trained GRURec network per category uses separate 96-dimensional history and candidate embedding tables, a two-layer GRU, strictly causal attention over earlier recurrent states, and a projection with layer normalization. Scores combine normalized feature–candidate similarity, a learned scale capped at 30, and jointly trained item bias. Training uses 64-negative sampled-softmax cross-entropy, AdamW, AMP on CUDA, gradient clipping, and validation checkpoint selection. The predictor routes all four categories and strictly loads exactly one checkpoint per category, including both embedding tables. Checks cover finite gradients, causality, independent candidate parameters, zero padding, and checkpoint reload parity. No ensemble or separately fitted scoring component is used.
